title: TLSNotary
description: EXPERIMENTAL, opt-in. Opt-in private TLS notarization of the top-level HTTPS response, capped at 48 KiB by default; larger responses are explicitly labelled partial. Adds MPC computation and substantial network traffic, slowing archiving. A public notary corroborates encrypted traffic and signs commitments without receiving URL paths, query strings, cookies, or page content. Timing, traffic sizes and your IP remain visible; destination metadata may be observable. The saved artifact contains the URL and content: share it deliberately. No images, scripts, video streams or other subresources are notarized.

TLSNOTARY_ENABLED.description: Enable private MPC attestation; adds seconds or minutes, substantial bandwidth and several GB of client RAM per top-level HTTPS response.

TLSNOTARY_NOTARY_URL.description: Public bounded-capture endpoint. Self-hosters must run the matching plugin runtime; loopback WS is permitted for development.

TLSNOTARY_TRUSTED_KEY.description: Trusted secp256k1 public key in hex. Empty uses the bundled ArchiveBox key. Never trust a key merely because an artifact contains it.

TLSNOTARY_BINARY.description: Path to the plugin's abx-tlsnotary native binary; empty builds the bundled pinned Rust source in ABXPKG_LIB_DIR.

TLSNOTARY_CARGO_BINARY.description: Cargo executable for source installation; requires Rust 1.95 or newer.

TLSNOTARY_MAX_RECV_BYTES.description: MPC response budget including headers. Public ArchiveBox service permits 48 KiB per session; larger values require a separately provisioned notary.

TLSNOTARY_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum seconds per top-level notarization; no automatic retries.

TLSNOTARY_PREFIX_BYTES.description: Bounded capture (48 KiB by default): 0 requires the complete response; otherwise use at least 32768 and at most TLSNOTARY_MAX_RECV_BYTES. Requests gzip encoding and stops at a complete TLS record boundary. The proof and verifier explicitly label incomplete responses. A byte prefix does not certify a video duration.
